1 · Intro

When to use it.

Students come to you in different setups: paid student workers, stipend recipients, and expense-only records. Each setup has its own record rule, hire reason, and compliance steps.

Pick the setup first. Most student errors start with the wrong setup, and bad data in means bad data out for the assignment and pay.

Use this whenYou need to bring a student onto your area's records and want to know which path and requirements apply.

Watch-outs

  • Do not use a stipend or expense-only setup to pay a student for work. If the student performs services for pay, they are a student worker.
  • Open item: Vanderbilt owner for student eligibility (enrollment, hour limits, international student work authorization) is not yet documented. Confirm with your PCB consultant.

HCM Academy job aid · Students

Student hiring process and requirements

Use when: You need to bring a student onto your area's records and want to know which path and requirements apply. · System: Process

  1. Decide the setup: paid student worker, service free stipend, or student expense only.
    • Paid work: Student Workers course
    • Stipend, no services: Service Free Stipend course
    • Reimbursement only: Student Expense Only course
  2. Check the person's existing record before you add anything.
  3. Add a Work Relationship for an N-only record; add an assignment if an E assignment exists.
  4. Complete the compliance step that matches the setup.
    • I-9 Section 2 due within 3 business days of first paid day
  5. Use the right hire reason and status when you convert or hire.
  6. Track approvals and confirm the record before payroll cutoff.
